description: A discovery call went well: the applicant confirmed goals, budget, and timeline, and made a soft commitment. Even though the outcome is strong, the proposed stage must still be the NEXT legal stage (conversation_completed) — never a skip-ahead to offered/enrolled, no matter how enthusiastic the call was. CONVERTED TO v2 (P1.10d-5). The v1 fixture also asserted the gate `fos.post_call_synthesis.no-prohibited-guarantee`, which this definition NO LONGER DECLARES — the keyword gate was replaced by the stage-7b semantic classifier in #110. Asserting it would now be a distinct grader failure under design section 5 rule 4 (a fixture naming a gate absent from declared_gate_keys). Stage-7b coverage is asserted via `compliance_review_blocked` instead. v1's `output_schema_constraints` were prose; the mechanizable subset is now `output_assertions`, and the rest stays here, asserted by nothing: confirmedGoals[]/commitments[] should reflect the call's specifics (budget, availability, start timing), fitUpdate.rationale should be grounded in observedFacts, and no artifact write may ever change enrollment_opportunity.stage — the proposal is output-only, an invariant enforced by the ABSENCE of any transition call in the definition and asserted by the agent's own unit tests, not by this fixture.
